CARTESCATS.GMOnly: Only the Game Master can open the card dealer.
CARTESCATS.ResetDeckConfirm: This reshuffles the whole deck and clears every player's hand. Continue?
CARTESCATS.DragHint: Drag a player from one column to the other to add or remove them from the participants (double-click also works).
CARTESCATS.NoParticipants: Drag at least one player into the participants.
CARTESCATS.NotEnoughCards: You'd need {requested} card(s) but only {remaining} are left in the deck. Lower the amounts or reset the deck.
CARTESCATS.NoCardsYet: You haven't received any cards yet.
CARTESCATS.TradeProposed: Trade offer sent to {name}, waiting for their answer.
CARTESCATS.NoOtherPlayers: No other player is currently connected for a trade.
CARTESCATS.NoCardsToGive: You have no card to give in return.
CARTESCATS.TradeDeclinedNotice: {name} declined your trade offer for the {card} card.
CARTESCATS.TargetOffline: That player needs to be connected to receive a trade offer.
CARTESCATS.ProposerOffline: The player who proposed the trade is no longer connected, the trade was cancelled.
CARTESCATS.CardConfigHint: Pick a custom image for each card (and for the deck back). Reset restores the module's original artwork.
